title: A moved bank figure typed later with no time of its own (cfg.bankNow with no bankNowAt, decision K3)
story: A 38.31 copy, last saved Tue 24 Nov 2026 at 08:00, is moved that morning. Its first bank figure, 300,000, was typed on Sun 22 Nov at 18:00 (bankStart with its bankAt), so the bank opens on 22 Nov, told at 18:00. A later figure, 294,000 (bankNow), has no bankNowAt. K3: it is dated to the copy's last saved day, 24 Nov; J2: a moved bank figure with no time of its own is told at the copy's last save, 08:00. Its receipts: 4,000 on Mon 23 Nov and 1,000 on 24 Nov, both with no time, so each is told at the start of its day (J2) and is inside the 24 Nov figure. In the new app a lunch of 1,500 is logged on 24 Nov at 12:00, after the figure. The 24 Nov figure carries no date in the file: the move dates it. No holidays are listed. Every amount is made up.

asks.why: 295,000 (what the events say on 24 Nov before the figure: 300,000 - 4,000 - 1,000) - 294,000 (the moved bankNow) = 1,000
